response.text: {"label": "misread_spec", "reason": "The target needs a good 3C word left pending (tready low) and then accepted during a later bad frame's frame_error strobe, as in gold's `154 ... rx hs 3c` together with `154 ... rx frame_error 1`; the sub instead ties tready high and sends only one bad-stop frame, so no hs ever occurs and only bare frame errors appear (`413 ... rx frame_error 1`, repeating) — its #bit_clks delay in ns is also only 5 cycles per bit."}
